name: Something Bit
dialogue: Before we talk business, show me the water knows your name. Three fish ought to do it.
conclusion: Three catches. Good start. Here is something for the next cast.
objective: Catch any 3 fish. Keep them or sell them; both count.

name: Know Your Catch
dialogue: A fish is never just a fish. Get to know three different ones, then pick something for your tackle box.
conclusion: You are learning their names. Choose your next little advantage.
objective: Discover 3 different ordinary species. Earlier discoveries count.

name: Nothing Wasted
dialogue: Someone calls it rubbish. I call it tomorrow's rod fittings. Pull up a piece of junk and recover its materials.
conclusion: See? Even a disappointing bite can be useful. A few more fittings for your trouble.
objective: Recover materials from 1 junk catch. Materials are salvaged automatically.

name: A Proper Setup
dialogue: A good rod earns its scars. Give any rod its first quality upgrade; earlier upgrades count too.
conclusion: Now that looks like your rod. Put this toward your next purchase.
objective: Upgrade any rod to Uncommon or better.

name: A Favor Returned
dialogue: One last favor: supper for the dock crew. Bring one of these common pond fish. You choose which keeper to part with.
conclusion: Pull up a chair, Dock Regular. There is always room for you here.
objective: Deliver 1 F, D or C rank fish from one of the 3 listed pond species.

name: River Rumors
dialogue: Something took my best hook. Before you laugh, learn the river. Five different species should give us a place to start.
conclusion: Five witnesses, all with fins. We are getting somewhere.
objective: Discover 5 different ordinary species in Whispering River.

name: A Bigger Story
dialogue: My fish was enormous. Yours only needs to be longer than its species' typical length. Fair compromise?
conclusion: That is a respectable fish. Mine was bigger, naturally.
objective: Catch a river fish longer than its species' typical length. Earlier catches count.

name: Something to Compare
dialogue: Bring me a common river specimen. I want to check its markings against the one in my notes.
conclusion: Same markings. Wrong size. Keep looking; I will keep this one for the comparison.
objective: Deliver 1 F, D or C rank fish from one of the 3 listed river species.

name: The One That Stayed
dialogue: All right. Land an S rank or better river fish and we will settle this. No deadline. Good stories take their time.
conclusion: Rowan turns over an old sketch. The legendary monster is a very ordinary fish, drawn much too close. Your catch, however, is real. For once, he has nothing to add.
objective: Catch an S, SS, SSS, UR or UUR fish in Whispering River. Keep it.

name: Fish for the Crew
dialogue: Keep the crew supplied. Every fish caught this week counts; no handover needed.
conclusion: The crew sends their thanks. And their coin.
objective: Catch 15 fish this week.

name: Useful Scraps
dialogue: The workshop could use a hand. Recover materials from three junk catches this week.
conclusion: Waste nothing. Build something.
objective: Recover materials from 3 junk catches this week.

name: A Varied Haul
dialogue: Show me five different ordinary species caught this week. Even familiar fish count.
conclusion: A little variety makes the best tackle box. Pick your supplies.
objective: Catch 5 different ordinary species this week.

name: Missing by Morning
dialogue: My supply baskets keep vanishing. Learn who lives among these reeds before we accuse anything with teeth.
conclusion: Five residents accounted for. None willing to give a statement.
objective: Discover 5 ordinary species in Hollow Marsh. Earlier discoveries count.

name: A Trail of Scraps
dialogue: Recover ten pieces of junk, anywhere you fish. I want to compare the fittings with my missing baskets.
conclusion: These straps match. Something has been dragging the baskets into the water.
objective: Recover materials from 10 junk catches across any water. Earlier catches count.

name: Too Large for the Basket
dialogue: Find a marsh fish longer than its species usually grows. Perhaps our thief simply outgrew its hiding place.
conclusion: That would explain the torn reeds. And my very surprised apprentice.
objective: Catch a fish in Hollow Marsh longer than its species' typical length. Earlier catches count.

name: The Keeper of the Reeds
dialogue: Bring an S rank or better marsh catch into your records. Keep the fish; I only need proof for my new basket design.
conclusion: Nessa studies your catch, then hangs the baskets higher. The marsh keeps its secrets. You keep your fish.
objective: Catch an S rank or better fish in Hollow Marsh. Keep it. Earlier catches count.

name: An Unfinished Journal
dialogue: This journal names five lake residents without drawing them. Help me match the descriptions. Any hour will do.
conclusion: The first pages finally have names beside their sketches.
objective: Discover 5 ordinary species in Moonlit Lake. Earlier discoveries count.

name: Between the Pages
dialogue: There are ten different fish hidden in these notes. Some passages make more sense once you know their subjects.
conclusion: What looked like poetry was a remarkably detailed field guide.
objective: Discover 10 ordinary species in Moonlit Lake. Earlier discoveries count.

name: A Margin Too Small
dialogue: One drawing spills over its border. Record a lake fish longer than its typical length and we can test the proportions.
conclusion: The artist ran out of paper. Apparently that was the entire mystery.
objective: Catch a fish in Moonlit Lake longer than its species' typical length. Earlier catches count.

name: The Final Reflection
dialogue: An S rank or better lake catch will complete the final entry. There is no deadline, and the specimen stays yours.
conclusion: Elowen closes the restored journal. On its last page, she adds your name beside the original author.
objective: Catch an S rank or better fish in Moonlit Lake. Keep it. Earlier catches count.

name: Scattered Fittings
dialogue: Fifteen recovered junk catches should give me enough fittings to compare. Any water might hold a piece of the story.
conclusion: A repeated maker mark. These belonged to the same vessel.
objective: Recover materials from 15 junk catches across any water. Earlier catches count.

name: Along the Wreck Line
dialogue: Learn five coastal species. Their usual haunts might tell us where the current carried the wreck.
conclusion: Reef, shallows, open water. The trail bends toward the old mooring.
objective: Discover 5 ordinary species in Sunken Coast. Earlier discoveries count.

name: Supper for the Search
dialogue: The search crew cannot live on theories. Choose a common coastal fish for tonight's pot.
conclusion: One fish delivered, one crew delighted. Bram has already claimed the washing-up duty.
objective: Deliver 1 F, D or C rank fish from one of the 3 listed species in Sunken Coast.

name: A Weight on the Line
dialogue: Record a coastal fish longer than its usual size. Strong fish gather where the broken hull shelters them.
conclusion: Your measurements put the shelter exactly where the old chart marks a reef.
objective: Catch a fish in Sunken Coast longer than its species' typical length. Earlier catches count.

name: A Safe Harbor
dialogue: Land an S rank or better coastal fish for the harbor log. Keep it. We have taken enough from the sea today.
conclusion: The wreck is marked, the channel safe. Bram leaves its remaining treasures to the tide.
objective: Catch an S rank or better fish in Sunken Coast. Keep it. Earlier catches count.

name: Cold Introductions
dialogue: Five species will give us a useful starting sample. A notebook travels better than a frozen bucket.
conclusion: Five entries, no frozen specimens to carry. An excellent arrangement.
objective: Discover 5 ordinary species in Glacial Reach. Earlier discoveries count.

name: Beyond the Field Guide
dialogue: Record a glacial fish longer than its species' typical length. I suspect the old guide underestimated this water.
conclusion: The guide needs a correction. I have been waiting years to write that sentence.
objective: Catch a fish in Glacial Reach longer than its species' typical length. Earlier catches count.

name: Life Under the Surface
dialogue: Document ten glacial species. The ice hides much more variety than visitors expect.
conclusion: Ten lives beneath what most people call empty water.
objective: Discover 10 ordinary species in Glacial Reach. Earlier discoveries count.

name: The Icewater Report
dialogue: An S rank or better glacial catch will anchor the report. Your records are enough; keep the fish.
conclusion: Tavi signs the report with both your names. Next winter, the field guide will tell a better story.
objective: Catch an S rank or better fish in Glacial Reach. Keep it. Earlier catches count.

name: An Address Without a Shore
dialogue: An explorer left letters addressed to places below the sea. Learn five abyssal species and help me read the clues.
conclusion: These are habitats, not addresses. At last, a sensible explanation for the postage.
objective: Discover 5 ordinary species in Abyssal Shelf. Earlier discoveries count.

name: The Long Shadow
dialogue: One letter mentions a fish longer than expected. Record an unusually long abyssal specimen to check the description.
conclusion: The measurements match the explorer's notes. They really made it this far.
objective: Catch a fish in Abyssal Shelf longer than its species' typical length. Earlier catches count.

name: A Familiar Specimen
dialogue: Choose a common abyssal fish for the museum curator. Its markings may identify the final survey site.
conclusion: The curator recognizes the pattern. The last site was beside the vents.
objective: Deliver 1 F, D or C rank fish from one of the 3 listed species in Abyssal Shelf.

name: Return to Sender
dialogue: Land an S rank or better abyssal fish for the final survey entry. No handover; the catch belongs to you.
conclusion: The explorer returns to collect the letters personally. Orin hands over a bill for several years of storage.
objective: Catch an S rank or better fish in Abyssal Shelf. Keep it. Earlier catches count.

name: A Box of Possibilities
dialogue: Five recovered junk catches will help refill my parts tray. Nothing becomes useful until someone gives it a second look.
conclusion: Pip sorts the fittings by a system only Pip understands.
objective: Recover materials from 5 junk catches across any water. Earlier catches count.

name: An Uncommon Fix
dialogue: Show me a rod of Uncommon quality or better. An existing upgrade is every bit as instructive.
conclusion: Good fittings, properly seated. That rod has room to grow.
objective: Upgrade any rod to Uncommon or better. Existing quality counts.

name: A Rare Improvement
dialogue: Bring any rod to Rare quality. Keep using the one you like; this is about craftsmanship.
conclusion: Pip makes one tiny adjustment and refuses to explain how long it took to learn.
objective: Upgrade any rod to Rare or better. Existing quality counts.

name: Built to Last
dialogue: An Epic quality rod will finish the demonstration. Take your time gathering the materials.
conclusion: The demonstration becomes a workshop lesson. Pip presents you with a badge, then immediately asks to borrow a tool.
objective: Upgrade any rod to Epic or better. Existing quality counts.

name: Names Before Numbers
dialogue: Start with ten ordinary species. Every good collection begins with noticing what is already there.
conclusion: Ten names, ten little stories. A promising first shelf.
objective: Discover 10 ordinary species in any water. Earlier discoveries count.

name: Different Measures
dialogue: Find five different ranks across ordinary fish. A small specimen belongs in the story too.
conclusion: Sera rearranges the display so the smaller catches get their own light.
objective: Discover 5 different ranks across ordinary species in any water. Earlier catches count.

name: Room for the Unexpected
dialogue: Record eight different ranks. They can come from different species and different waters.
conclusion: The collection now shows how much variety a familiar fish can hold.
objective: Discover 8 different ranks across ordinary species in any water. Earlier catches count.

name: Exactly Right
dialogue: One last, patient pursuit: a fish at its own rank's exact maximum length and weight. Any ordinary species, any rank. This is only for the badge; take as long as you like.
conclusion: Sera checks both measurements twice, smiles, and leaves a perfect little space around your name.
objective: Catch any ordinary species at the exact maximum length AND weight for its rank. Earlier rank maxima count.

name: Another Basketful
dialogue: Ten fresh fish will fill the next basket. Keep them or sell them; I only need your catch tally.
conclusion: Supplies paid. Another run is available whenever you are ready.
objective: Catch 10 fish this run. No handover required.

name: Workshop Supply Run
dialogue: Recover materials from five fresh junk catches. The workshop always has another repair waiting.
conclusion: Supplies paid. Another run is available whenever you are ready.
objective: Recover materials from 5 junk catches this run.

name: Fresh Variety
dialogue: Bring five different ordinary species into your catch log for this run. Familiar species count again.
conclusion: Supplies paid. Another run is available whenever you are ready.
objective: Catch 5 different ordinary species this run.
